title: 빙하 왕관탑
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A NEW tall frost/cooling TOWER for RuneNexus fantasy tower defense. The user explicitly REJECTED flat squat designs. It must have an impressive upright tower silhouette, total height about 2.5 times base width, substantial vertical body and a visually rich sculptural upper crown. Main challenge: attractive BOTH in diagonal view AND from straight overhead. Solve that with a sculptural three-dimensional head/crown with broad readable shapes and radial/asymmetric depth, NOT by flattening the tower. Create a single landscape two-view sheet: LEFT large elevated 3/4 view showing the full tall tower, RIGHT a smaller true TOP view showing the very same object's complete overhead silhouette. Label only '3/4' and 'TOP'. Not a collage of variants. Top view must actually look straight down, and be geometrically consistent with the 3/4 view. The taller object remains tall even when viewed from above. Polished but practical stylized 3D game concept, chunky bevels, clear material separation, restrained detail readable in game, dark carved stone and gunmetal, restrained bronze fittings, deep translucent blue ice with frosted pale edges, controlled icy cyan glow. Neutral charcoal studio background, soft light and contact shadows, no scenery/UI, no distracting VFX or cinematic microdetail. Compact low mounting plinth but TALL main body, entire tower visible with margins. Do not make a ground trap, flat platform, disk, flat snowflake, short well, low bowl, or squat emitter. Do not copy the earlier two-pillar crystal reliquary. Design: A tall thick faceted stone column carries a large open ice crown. FIVE thick curved translucent ice prongs flare outward and upward around a visible blue spherical core seated high at the crown center, like upward sweeping glacier horns. Tips are blunt-faceted, and the prongs have broad curved shoulders so the top view reads as a rich five-lobed crown surrounding a luminous center, not five tiny dots. Each prong has a bronze root socket. Long central stone shaft with three deep vertical icy grooves, no broad empty dish. Crown occupies upper 40 percent of total tower height.
